item.title: DeepSeek Is No Longer Cheap: When the Price Disruptor Starts Charging for Compute
item.description: DeepSeek's peak and off-peak API pricing is more than a routine adjustment. It exposes the tension between low-price positioning, user expectations, and the real cost of running large models.

item.title: Prompt Caching——Claude Code's "Money-Saving Secret"
item.description: Deep dive into Claude Code's prompt caching mechanism: cache breakpoint design, tool ordering stability, and cache interruption detection. Unveiling how prompt caching dramatically reduces API call costs, and why tool ordering must remain stable.

item.title: Cloudflare's New Crawl API: Finally, You Don't Have to Write Crawlers Anymore?
item.description: Cloudflare's new /crawl endpoint makes web scraping as easy as ordering takeout. One API call, and their browser does all the heavy lifting for you.

item.title: Teaching AI to Look Things Up: Claude Search & Retrieval Guide
item.description: Claude search and retrieval basics: Use the API to search Wikipedia, scrape web pages, and build personal knowledge bases. Includes complete WikipediaSearchTool code examples.

item.title: Say Goodbye to encodeURIComponent() in 2025
item.description: Build cleaner URLs with the new URL() API and ditch the tedious encodeURIComponent() approach
